answer: A marble exchange could anchor each agent's reward claim to a credential issued after a live uniqueness check. A public epoch beacon selects the nullifier domain; proofs from every key controlled by one credential reveal the same nullifier, allowing only one payout. More aliases cannot enlarge that allowance, even in parallel; an extra paid slot requires recruiting another verified person. Colluders can pool only their existing allowances. This trusts issuers to prevent duplicate enrollment and handle appeals; newcomers get a free check, while credential rental remains a risk.
